specification.problem: Distinguish a pair of cospectral non-isomorphic graphs G and G' (e.g. G4(n;n+2), G5(n;n+2)) using a continuous-time quantum walk of two noninteracting fermions, whose Hamiltonian is the adjacency matrix acting on the antisymmetric two-particle subspace. Distinguishing is by a difference in output distributions or return amplitudes at a chosen time t.
specification.reconstruction_scope: One tiny explicit instance: N<=8 vertices (3 qubits per position register, 6 qubits plus 1 optional Hadamard-test ancilla). The two adjacency matrices are given explicitly and are not hidden in a black box. Covers building H2 on the antisymmetric subspace, a fixed antisymmetric initial state, evolution by exp(-i H2 t), and readout by position-basis distribution or return amplitude, compared by total variation distance. Outside scope: the entanglement-entropy calculation for harmonic-oscillator networks, the analytic derivations for general n, the T4/T5 graph construction, and any specific edge lists of G4/G5, which the abstract does not give.

symbols.meaning: adjacency matrices of G and G'

symbols.domain: vectors in C^{N^2}, dimension N(N-1)/2 subspace

symbols.meaning: probability of measuring |ij> in the position registers
total variation distance between output distributions

equations.label: Antisymmetric matrix elements
equations.description: Matrix elements of H2 in the antisymmetric fermionic basis, for i<j and k<l.
equations.abstract_quote: we rewrite the adjacency matrices of graphs in the antisymmetric fermionic basis
equations.justification: The abstract says the adjacency matrices are rewritten in the antisymmetric fermionic basis. The explicit formula is standard noninteracting two-fermion algebra, not quoted from the paper.

equations.label: Two-particle Hamiltonian
equations.description: Sum of single-particle terms. It commutes with SWAP, so it preserves the antisymmetric subspace.
equations.justification: Standard construction for noninteracting multiparticle walks.

equations.label: Evolution and readout probability
equations.description: Walk from a fixed antisymmetric initial state. Probabilities are read in the position basis.
equations.justification: Proposed concrete instance. The abstract does not specify the initial state or the observable.
assumptions: The same (i,j) is used for G and G'
Time t is chosen so that the distributions differ

equations.label: Distinguishing criterion
equations.description: Non-isomorphism is certified if the distributions differ at some t. Equal distributions certify nothing.
equations.justification: The abstract says the walk distinguishes the pairs, but the statistic is chosen here.
assumptions: Exact statevector simulation, with no sampling noise

equations.label: Moment criterion
equations.description: The antisymmetric-sector spectra differ for some k even though the single-particle spectra coincide. The exact formula is omitted. Only the inequality is the claim.
equations.abstract_quote: show that they are different for these pairs of graphs
equations.justification: The abstract claims the antisymmetric representations differ, so the spectra or traces differ for some k. This is an inference.
assumptions: The explicit trace formula is not claimed

registers.name: r1
registers.role: position of particle 1, little-endian binary vertex index

registers.name: r2
registers.role: position of particle 2, little-endian binary vertex index

registers.name: anc
registers.role: optional Hadamard-test ancilla, used only for the return-amplitude variant

specification.initial_state: Directly prepare the antisymmetric state (|i>|j>-|j>|i>)/sqrt2 with standard gates: for example, X gates to set |i>|j>, then H on a control and CNOT-based exchange, or a controlled-SWAP construction. Avoid initialize. The abstract does not specify the state.

steps.description: Fix the explicit adjacency matrices A and A' for a tiny cospectral non-isomorphic pair with N<=8. Embed them into 2^3-dimensional registers, padding unused vertices with zero rows and columns.
Prepare the fixed antisymmetric initial state on r1 and r2, identically for both graphs.

Apply exp(-i H2 t), as exp(-iAt) on r1 and exp(-iAt) on r2 since the two terms commute. Implement with a Pauli decomposition of A and Trotterization using PauliEvolutionGate or standard gates. The evolution preserves the antisymmetric subspace.
Measure r1 and r2 in the computational basis for a few chosen t. Compute the distributions for G and G' and their total variation distance.

specification.measurement: Computational-basis measurement of both position registers (6 bits). Remember Qiskit's little-endian counts keys. Alternatively read the statevector directly for exact probabilities.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Compute d_TV between the G and G' distributions at each t. Declare non-isomorphic if d_TV exceeds a tolerance. Optionally compare tr(H2^k) restricted to the antisymmetric subspace classically.
assumptions: Small N so qubits fit under the cap
Evolution by Trotterization or Pauli decomposition
Fixed antisymmetric initial state, the same for both graphs
Distinguishing is by a difference in distributions at a chosen t
Exact edge lists of G4 and G5 are not given in the abstract and must be supplied by the task or by the next researcher
missing_information: Explicit edge lists of G4(n;n+2) and G5(n;n+2) and of T4/T5
The paper's initial state and observable
Details of the harmonic-oscillator entanglement entropy calculation, which is excluded from the circuit
